purpose: Test whether pre-action conformal predictions match final bounded-horizon task outcomes.
model_and_prompt: Same Qwen 0.5B checkpoint and unchanged MiniWoB prompt as earlier smoke runs.
change_from_smoke: Four independent continuation samples per checkpoint; fresh prospective seeds.
primary_rule: Only singleton failure is a failure alarm; uncertainty is not counted as a correct prediction.
primary_metrics: false alarm rate among successful episodes
fixed_descriptive_baselines: always predict failure before the first action
alarm at first checkpoint with q < 0.5
limitations: One microtask template, not distinct benchmark task families.
Three-action horizon, not a long-horizon test.
Sample size may be inadequate within rare outcome classes.
Do not tune model, prompt, alpha, or score settings after inspecting evaluation results.
